resources.name: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE)
quotes: We utilize CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) reports to identify vulnerable JavaScript libraries.
Furthermore, we manually investigate the fidelity of CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) reports on client-side resources, leveraging PoC (Proof of Concept) code.
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The authors used CVE reports to identify vulnerable JavaScript libraries and conducted a specific analysis on the accuracy of the version information provided in these reports.

resources.name: CVE Details
quotes: We also collect the vulnerability information of affected resources’ versions from multiple third-party websites for cross-reference, such as the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) [45], CVE MITRE Corporation [40], cvedetails.com [41], and SNYK Vul. DB [50].
references: [41] 2022. CVE security vulnerability database. Security vulnerabilities, exploits, references and more. https://www.cvedetails.com/index.php. (Accessed on 05/26/2023).
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The authors used cvedetails.com as one of the third-party sources to collect vulnerability information for affected resource versions.
